text_block_list.text:
One day, Мэдзиро Райан drags me out to
an
unpopulated island.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Take a look at that awesome
rock wall!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
This island is a pretty well-known natural
rock
climbing spot.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Yep, I'm gonna climb up! Wait for me up
top,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Ryan heads off to climb the cliff, and I
start to
walk up the slope that leads to
its summit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She keeps climbing, relying only on raw
physical
strength, until she's finally close
to the top.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: But her endurance is reaching its limit!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Just a little more, almost there...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I came this far... I have to make it to the
top!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Whew! I made it! This exhaustion feels
great!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Hey, thanks for reaching out to me!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
It feels like my entire body got stronger.
My arms,
shoulders, back, legs...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
In fact, I bet I could run any race I want
to right
now! Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан seems to have grown
stronger after
overcoming her rocky
ascent.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
